lines: Where AI, the web, and blockchain come together.
Traditional smart contracts execute predefined rules.
But the real world is constantly changing.
And valuable information appears across websites and documents, every second.
Traditional smart contracts cannot naturally read webpages, understand documents, or interpret real-world events.
This is where GenLayer comes in.
With Intelligent Contracts, GenLayer aims to overcome these limits, enabling AI-powered interpretation of real-world information.
Imagine a world where a prediction market can determine whether an event actually happened.
An insurance contract can evaluate information about an incident.
And an AI agent can assess a website before making a payment.
These applications need more than raw data.
They need to interpret information, evaluate evidence, and make decisions based on real-world conditions.
GenLayer combines web access, AI, and its Optimistic Democracy consensus, to handle decisions that traditional smart contracts struggle to process.
Of course, web access doesn't guarantee accuracy.
Information can be outdated, misleading, or manipulated.
That's why validation and consensus are essential.
GenLayer's vision goes beyond simply executing code.
It's about intelligent contracts that examine the real world, and support decentralized decisions when outcomes aren't straightforward.
Opening new possibilities for prediction markets, smart insurance, and the emerging economy of AI agents.
The future of smart contracts isn't just about executing code.
It's about expanding what they can understand, and do, with the world around them.
